evidence.summary: The privileged delete operation has no admin permission check.

findings.rationale: An authenticated user may access another user's privileged operation.
findings.remediation: Enforce the required permission before resolving or mutating the target resource.

findings.rationale: No substantiation for the quantitative customer claim was present in the supplied evidence.
findings.remediation: Supply substantiation or remove the claim.
limitations: Only the supplied repository and documents were reviewed.

evidence.summary: The analytics event spreads the full user object into its payload.

findings.rationale: The event may send more personal data than the feature requires.
findings.remediation: Allowlist only the fields required for the event.
limitations: The provider's received payload was not observed at runtime.

findings.rationale: No assistive-technology runtime was available, so source review cannot establish compatibility.
